artStyle: Comic-book style 3D game asset: chunky simplified shapes, flat solid colours with no gradients, even flat lighting, no baked shadows or highlights.
notes: Outlines and toon shading are added in code, so every prompt asks for flat colour and even light.
All three fighters use the same humanoid rig (Humanoid, Mixamo preset, Auto Rig), so any clip can play on any of them.
Export every rigged fighter as GLB with 2K textures (heroes: 4K as Tripo makes them), skeleton on, Number of Animations = Select All, Animation stay in Place = on.
The five weapons are one Tripo model with parts (kind 'parts'); each part hangs on Juno's hand_r attach point in code.

entries.prompt: Comic-book style 3D game asset: chunky simplified shapes, flat solid colours with no gradients, even flat lighting, no baked shadows or highlights. Juno, a young woman bike courier who boxes, 1.7 metres tall with an athletic build, standing in a T-pose facing the camera, arms straight out to the sides level with her shoulders, hands open, feet apart with a clear gap between the legs. Her head is about one sixth of her height, her arms are long enough to reach mid-thigh, her body is no wider than her shoulders, and there is space between her arms, legs and body. Short dark hair tied in a tight bun under a snug teal cycling cap with a short peak. A zipped teal nylon courier jacket fitted to the body with stitched panel seams, thin reflective silver stripes on the sleeves and a small yellow lightning-bolt patch on the chest; fitted navy cycling trousers with darker knee patches; chunky yellow-and-white sneakers; bright yellow boxing hand wraps on both hands with visible wrapping. Fabric shows light scuffs at the knees and elbows. Nothing hangs loose: no bag, no straps, no scarf, no ponytail. Single isolated object, centered, on a plain white background.

animations.check: may come out as a side kick; turn it in code if so
must end lying on the ground; plain 'defeat' only sways

animations.clip: backswing: a woman swings a short stick held in her right hand backhand from her left side across to her right, then returns to a ready stance
overhead: a woman lifts a stick above her head with both hands and brings it down hard in front of her, then returns to a ready stance

entries.notes: slash, backswing and overhead are only used while holding a weapon; the weapon hangs on the hand_r attach point in code, so Juno's model is made empty-handed.

entries.notes: Tripo splits this into five pieces; in code each piece is matched to a weapon, re-pivoted to its grip, turned so its length runs along +Z and scaled to its slot length. Each is shown above its pad and hung on Juno's hand_r attach point when bought.

builtInCode.roof: Built in code with a painted canvas texture (done): stained concrete slabs, tar seams, a dashed yellow NO PARKING square, two drain grates and halftone dots.
builtInCode.parapet: Built in code with a painted brick texture and a light cap stone (done).
builtInCode.sky: Built in code (done): a banded sunset gradient and a ring of skyline blocks with lit windows.
builtInCode.lights: The lamp glow is a light added in code above each lamp_post model.
builtInCode.lamp_post: Built in code (pole, lamp box and a real light): it is thin and simple, and it frees a Tripo entry for the weapons.
builtInCode.coin: Built in code: a gold toon cylinder with a mark, spun and bounced in code. Many coins can be on screen, so it stays a few dozen triangles.
builtInCode.weapon_pad: Built in code: a hazard-striped floor ring texture, dimmed while its weapon is locked.

budget.busiestMoment: A boss wave late in a run: Juno, Grudge and four Crows (5 enemies on the roof is the cap), plus all props and the five weapons on display.

triangles.weapons: the weapons model 10000 x 1.5 (split model) = 15000, shown once on the pads plus one held piece (up to about 3000)
triangles.coins: up to about 25 at once, about 100 triangles each with outline = 2500
triangles.phone: OK for most phones from the last few years; on an old phone, turn off outlines on the weapons on display and shadows on coins first

textureMemory.asTripoMakesThem: about 700 MB: two heroes with three 4K maps each = 536 MB, crow and crow_elite 2K colour maps 22 MB each, four other models 22 MB each (the weapons model has one map per piece, smaller for small pieces)
textureMemory.afterShrinkOnLoad: about 52 MB: fighters shrunk to 1024, props and weapons to 512, plus about 3 MB of canvas textures painted in code
textureMemory.plan: Shrink textures on load (stage 5) and ship WebP at those sizes (stage 6).
